title: Tools for Responsible ML: SageMaker Clarify and SageMaker Model Monitor

cues.en: Hello, and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we're talking about AWS tools for responsible AI.
cues.zh: 今天談 AWS 負責任 AI 工具。

cues.en: Now, there are a few tools.
cues.zh: 有幾個工具。

cues.en: There's three tools specifically you need to know for the exam, and the first one of them is SageMaker Clarify.
cues.zh: 考試特別要知道三個，第一 SageMaker Clarify。

cues.en: And keep an eye out for this one because it does come up on the exam quite often.
cues.zh: 注意，它很常考。

cues.en: Now, SageMaker Clarify is a tool that provides evaluations of data and models specifically for the following things: First one is bias and imbalance.
cues.zh: 它評估資料與模型，主要包括偏見、不平衡。

cues.en: So it can evaluate your data for bias and imbalance.
cues.zh: 可檢查資料偏見、不平衡。

cues.en: If you're on the exam, you see imbalanced dataset or biased dataset, then the answer might be related to SageMaker Clarify.
cues.zh: 考試看到不平衡或有偏見的資料集，答案可能 Clarify。

cues.en: Also, you can evaluate your model for bias if it is making predictions with bias.
cues.zh: 也能檢查模型預測是否有偏見。

cues.en: Also, SageMaker Clarify can evaluate your model prediction explainability.
cues.zh: 還能評估預測的可解釋性。

cues.en: So which features are the most important ones, Which features are less important, which have the biggest impact on the predictions and things like that.
cues.zh: 哪些特徵重要、較不重要、對預測影響最大等等。

cues.en: So if you see that on the exam, then the answer, again, might be SageMaker Clarify.
cues.zh: 考試遇到這些，也可能 Clarify。

cues.en: The second tool to keep in mind is SageMaker Model Monitor.
cues.zh: 第二 SageMaker Model Monitor。

cues.en: Again, it does come up on the exam quite a bit, and what this tool is used for is data quality monitoring in an ongoing way.
cues.zh: 也常考，持續監控資料品質。

cues.en: So SageMaker Clarify can help you evaluate one-off if the data has bias or imbalances and things like that, whereas SageMaker Model Monitor can do that
cues.zh: Clarify 可單次評估偏見、不平衡，Model Monitor 則能

cues.en: in an ongoing way to see if there's certain, like if you see on the exam things like data drift, then that might be related to SageMaker Model Monitor,
cues.zh: 持續監控，例如考試看到 Data drift，可能是它，

cues.en: 'cause you can find those things.
cues.zh: 能找出漂移。

cues.en: Also, Model Quality Monitoring, so is the model predicting as well as it was at the start, as well as it should be, again in an ongoing way.
cues.zh: 也持續監控模型品質，是否和一開始一樣、符合應有水準。

cues.en: And Model Deviation Alert and Notice.
cues.zh: 模型偏離警報與通知。

cues.en: So it can provide alerts when there are certain deviations in the data quality or model quality.
cues.zh: 資料或模型品質偏離，可發警報。

cues.en: And the final third tool is our Amazon Augmented AI.
cues.zh: 第三 Amazon Augmented AI。

cues.en: Again, this one does come up on the exam, maybe not as much as the first two, but it still might come up on your exam.
cues.zh: 也可能考，雖沒前兩者頻繁。

cues.en: And what you need to know here is that it's basically augmenting the review of models with humans added into the equation,
cues.zh: 要知道，它把人加入模型審查流程，

cues.en: so basically a human review of ML predictions.
cues.zh: 也就是人工審查 ML 預測。

cues.en: It's a tool that summarizes your models in a human-friendly format so that humans can easily review them.
cues.zh: 以人類容易理解的格式呈現，方便審查。

cues.en: And also, it actually even gives you access to an AWS-managed workforce, so if you don't want to set up your own team of people to review models, you can leverage an AWS-managed workforce
cues.zh: 甚至提供 AWS 管理的人力，如果不想自建審查團隊，也可使用

cues.en: using this tool as well.
cues.zh: 這個工具取得人力。

cues.en: So those are the three tools in AWS for responsible AI.
cues.zh: 這是三種 AWS 負責任 AI 工具。

cues.en: You are more than likely, very likely to get at least one of them, most likely two, and quite frankly, maybe even all three of them on the exam.
cues.zh: 考試很可能至少一個，多半兩個，也許三個全考。

cues.en: So good to know about all them.
cues.zh: 都值得知道。

cues.en: Here's a quick summary of what we discussed.
cues.zh: 快速整理。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy the Cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
